entities.summary: T. M. Chidambara Ragunathan, was a Tamil, writer, translator, journalist and literary critic from Tamil Nadu, India. He is also known as T. C. Ragunathan, Tho. Mu. Si. Ragunathan or by his Tamil initials as Tho.
